partido no reconocido: Tie-breaker rules for the EC2000 qualifying groups to be
partido no reconocido: applied when two (or more) teams finish equal on points:
partido no reconocido: 1) Points in mutual encounters between those teams.
partido no reconocido: 2) Goal difference in mutual encounters between those teams.
partido no reconocido: 3) Away goals in mutual encounters between those teams.
partido no reconocido: 4) Total goal difference (against all other teams)
partido no reconocido: 5) Total goals scored (against all other teams)
partido no reconocido: 6) Total away goals scored (against all other teams)
partido no reconocido: The best second place finisher (computed by records against teams
partido no reconocido: finishing first, third and fourth) qualifies automatically; the
partido no reconocido: other eight enter a random draw for two-legged playoff matches from
partido no reconocido: which four more countries qualify.
